notes.title: Game-Update / Devlog #4
notes.content:
Hi all,

Slight disappointment! My goal of having a reasonably oke demo for the steam-next fest in october is not going to happen. Only three days before the sign-up day for the festival is over. Too much work for too little time. 

I had good hopes that during the holidays my extra time available would be sufficient, unfortunately it wasn't! Had some friends played the latest version and there was still. again, too much to do.


That said, still happy with the progress made but it just isn't enough. 

-fixed tutorial map for 90% give or take. But you know, 10% is 90% of the work.

-added a sprint feature, small extra but needed to give a bit more sense of urgency

-changed HUD



See you soon,

Antihero

notes.title: Game-Update / Devlog #3
notes.content:
Hi all,

Another two weekly update; A slow two weeks. Designing the last area for the demo with a bit of a 'writers block'. But slowly getting the idea's in place. 

90% of the work is in the last 10%. Something I read before but it is making more and more sense. A game is never really finished.  

Regardless, a sort of roadmap. (subject to change)
Things to expect for the demo;

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45514820/1caabff229c7ce6508e52d5ddcd0fdf2ba3f1abd.png"]

A leader/scoreboard will be an important part of replay value. Different routes to finish the game but not all routes are doable from the start. Kiki can (dis)approve certain actions which will come back in the final score.

Back to work!
Antihero

notes.title: Game-Update / Devlog #2
notes.content:
Hi all,

More often then not my ideas come when I'm in bed for five minutes. They all seem great, easy to implement and very much vital!

 More often then not, the next evening is wasted on those idea's and ends on shift-deleting everything I worked on that evening. Usually its one of the following reasons; it's not easy to implement, it's not even fun or just does not work in the game as expected. Just another idea that took an arrow to the knee.



Releasing a demo during the october steam next fest is still the plan. That is still a few months away but game dev time flies unfortunately. At that time the demo needs to be fun and at least show where the game is (going) at.



It easy to get sidetracked, just as hopefully in the game, but first the base/essentials need to be done. Something I'll try to keep telling myself when I go to bed.



Next game-update I'll hopefully can provide a roadmap of some sort to see what I'm working on and what to expect.  Cheers,

Antihero

notes.title: Game-Update / Devlog #1
notes.content:
Hi all,
For all my loyal and not-so-loyal wishlisters, i thought it was time for a small update.

Good things first; A lot of progress is made! 
Bad things too; Still a lot more to do!

Its a long road of learning to code in unreal engine but its not impossible. Inefficient, yes fairly.
Keeping the game as simple as possible is fairly hard. Its easy to keep adding features which you didnt think of and suddenly want to add. (=learning and more inefficient coding).

While I'll try to stick to the deadline for a playable version (downgraded from end product already!) to be available at the steamnext fest in october, there is still lots of work to be done before that. I might ask for some playtesters in the end of summer for the panic coding afterwards.

Now back to business again!
Antihero
